title: FlightStrips combined airport configuration v1 (coded-handler proposal)
description: Single airport file with concrete compiled-handler settings. Reference datasets remain file resources. Demonstration loading is not production activation.

servicePDC.description: Airport availability/validation using the one application-level PDC service, provider client, transport, polling coordinator, and deployment HOPPIE_LOGON shared across airports. No airport-local credentials or polling configuration. Clearance state remains session-scoped.
